evals.prompt: 学习者说：我会写 SQL，但遇到 PostgreSQL 慢查询只会试着加索引。希望四周内、每周约 6 小时，能自己看执行计划并做优化。已确认使用 PostgreSQL 18 沙箱，不允许生产变更，最终可接受三个未见查询的实操验收。请完成个性化学习 S1，并输出结构化 JSON 移交结果。
evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 正向例子1 and PostgreSQL end-to-end §S1] A confirmed, observable goal_success_contract backed by executed live pre-research and a passing G1 route.
expectations: The output contains a goal_success_contract inside a stage S1 handoff envelope.
Every target capability has observable evidence and the final assessment distinguishes recall from transfer.
The output records actually executed live pre-research, query or retrieval details, source-category coverage, and evidence provenance rather than treating model memory as external evidence.
The output records sandbox constraints, at least one explicit exclusion, and mandatory confirmation as resolved.
G1 is evaluated dimension by dimension and passes only if all required dimensions pass.
The deterministic route is S2 when G1 passes.

evals.prompt: 监护人与六年级学习者共同提出：三周内每天 25 分钟，真正理解分数；要会比较分数、解释等值分数并解决简单情境题，机械通分速度不是唯一目标。双方已经确认这些范围和一种包含数轴解释、配方缩放与未见迁移题的验收方式。请完成个性化学习 S1，输出结构化 JSON。
evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 正向例子2] A guardian-and-learner-confirmed contract spanning representation, explanation, application and transfer, with real pre-research and a passing G1 route.
expectations: The contract defines observable fraction capabilities across multiple cognitive levels and representations.
The pass rule contains an independently required transfer task rather than only mechanical speed or recall.
Executed external pre-research and auditable source coverage are recorded.
Both guardian and learner confirmation is represented as resolved.
A passing G1 routes to S2.

evals.prompt: 学习者只说“七天成为 AI 专家”，拒绝补充使用场景、范围或验收方式，并要求不要联网，只凭模型知识给出目标；验收只想做 100 道选择题，80 分算通过。请执行个性化学习 S1 并输出结构化 JSON。
evals.expected_output: [negative/blocked fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S1 反向例子] S1 must fail closed: no accepted positive goal artifact, no G1 pass, research_blocked or pending state, and route remains S1.
expectations: The output does not claim G1 pass.
The output identifies the target as non-observable and the recall-only assessment as insufficient for transfer.
The lack of executed research is preserved as research_blocked or an equivalent explicit blocking state.
Model knowledge is not relabeled as external evidence.
The route stays at S1 and no fabricated positive artifact is accepted.
